name: Zendesk
oneLiner: Customer service platform (the Zendesk Resolution Platform) combining ticketing, messaging, voice, a help center and AI agents.
bestFor: Mid-size to large businesses, including multi-location restaurant and hospitality brands, that handle high contact volume across many channels.

updates.text: Announced (March 11) and completed (March 26) the acquisition of Forethought, an AI agent company; Forethought AI Agents by Zendesk cover chat, email and voice and add self-improving agents to the Resolution Platform.

features: Single agent workspace for email, messaging, live chat, social and voice
AI agents that answer common questions across chat, email and voice
Copilot add-on that suggests replies and next steps for human agents
Omnichannel routing and automated ticket triggers
Help center and knowledge base for self-service
Automated resolutions: AI agents are billed per request they resolve without escalation; Suite and Support plans include 5 per agent per month (10 on Suite Professional)
Suite Professional adds skills-based routing, an IVR phone tree, writing tools and Admin Copilot; Enterprise adds intelligent triage, Auto Assist and generative AI for voice

pricing.text: Support Team $19 per agent per month billed annually ($25 monthly); Suite Team $55 ($69 monthly); Suite Professional $115 ($149 monthly); Suite Enterprise + Copilot: talk to sales. 14-day free trial of Suite Professional. Copilot add-on $50 per agent per month (annual), for Professional and higher. Extra automated resolutions $1.50 committed or $2.00 pay-as-you-go.

notes: zendesk.com/pricing was read directly in November 2026 (earlier prices came from search snippets). Zendesk's own claim that its AI agents resolve over 80% of interactions was left out as a vendor claim. Original's 'hundreds of integrations' and 'millions of tickets' dropped. G2 rating from search snippets of the G2 product page (g2.com returns 403 to fetches).
pros: One agent workspace for email, messaging, live chat, social and voice
AI agents across chat, email and voice, extended in 2026 by the Forethought acquisition
Published per-agent prices and a 14-day trial of Suite Professional
Rated 4.3 out of 5 on G2 from more than 7,000 reviews
Food brands such as Grubhub, Grill'd and Impossible Foods run support on it

cons.text: Copilot, the agent assistant, is a paid add-on ($50 per agent per month billed annually) for Professional and higher plans
AI agents are billed per automated resolution beyond the plan's allowance of 5 or 10 per agent per month, at $1.50 committed or $2.00 pay-as-you-go
Support Team covers email and ticketing; AI agents, omnichannel routing and telephony start at Suite Team
Suite Enterprise pricing isn't published; you talk to sales
Built for customer service teams in every industry, so restaurant-specific work such as public review replies or loyalty offers may need another tool
